item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 01/Jun/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A hot southerly airstream will bring a few showers to the coast of Guangdong tomorrow. Meanwhile, the trough of low pressure over central China will edge closer to the coast of southern China. There will be showers and thunderstorms over the coastal areas in the following couple of days. With an anticyclone aloft strengthening gradually in the latter part of this week, showers will ease off and the weather will be hot over Guangdong.
